nodes.label: graphify update command
nodes.rationale: AST-only regeneration is required after code modifications so the graph stays current without incurring API cost.

nodes.label: GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Read only for broad architecture review or when query/path/explain do not surface enough context, because those commands return a scoped subgraph that is usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: graphify-out/wiki/index.md
nodes.rationale: Preferred for broad navigation instead of raw source browsing when it exists.

nodes.label: DropLife 'D' Monogram Icon

nodes.label: DropLife Brand

nodes.label: DropLife Wordmark Logo

nodes.label: Graphify Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Full build pipeline turning any folder of code/docs/papers/images/video into a persistent, queryable knowledge graph with three outputs: interactive HTML, GraphRAG-ready JSON, and GRAPH_REPORT.md.

nodes.label: Community Detection
nodes.rationale: Surfaces cross-document connections the user would not think to ask about; falls back from graspologic Louvain to NetworkX Louvain if graspologic is uninstalled.

nodes.label: Fast Path (Existing Graph Query)
nodes.source_location: SKILL.md 'What You Must Do When Invoked'
nodes.rationale: When graphify-out/graph.json already exists and the request is a natural-language question, skip the entire build pipeline and answer straight from the graph - the graph is already built, rebuilding wastes time and tokens.

nodes.label: Structural AST Extraction (Part A)
nodes.rationale: Deterministic and free: code is extracted via AST with no LLM and no API key, so a code-only corpus skips semantic extraction entirely.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction (Part B Subagents)
nodes.rationale: Docs/papers/images need an LLM; parallel general-purpose subagents (or Gemini if GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY is set) process 20-25-file chunks simultaneously - 5-10x faster than reading files one-by-one. Explore-type agents are forbidden because they cannot write chunk files, silently dropping results.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction Cache
nodes.rationale: Checked before dispatching any subagents so already-extracted files cost zero tokens on re-runs; stale cache files are deleted rather than merged (#1392).

nodes.label: Graph Health Check
nodes.rationale: Read-only integrity gate before labeling: surfaces edge collapse, dangling/missing endpoints, and self-loops - the silent-corruption modes of incremental updates and AST/LLM id mismatches. Never aborts; warnings must be surfaced per the Honesty Rules.

nodes.label: Graph Shrink Guard
nodes.rationale: to_json refuses to write when the new graph is smaller than the existing graph.json (#479), and the empty-graph guard runs before any write, so an empty or partial extraction can never clobber a good graph.json/GRAPH_REPORT.md (#1392).

nodes.label: Graphify Python Interpreter Detection
nodes.rationale: uv/pipx-aware detection (fixes #831): the interpreter that actually has graphify installed is saved to graphify-out/.graphify_python and every subsequent step runs through it instead of a bare python3.

nodes.label: Interactive HTML Graph Visualization
nodes.rationale: Generated by default; auto-aggregates to community view above 5000 nodes, and the Honesty Rules forbid running it on >5000 nodes without warning the user.

nodes.label: URL Ingest (/graphify add)
nodes.rationale: Auto-detects URL type (YouTube via yt-dlp, Twitter via oEmbed, arXiv, PDF, images, generic webpages via html2text), saves to ./raw, then runs the --update pipeline to merge the new file into the existing graph.

nodes.label: Watch Mode (--watch)
nodes.rationale: Background watcher with 3s debounce so a wave of parallel agent writes triggers one rebuild, not one per file. Code-only changes rebuild immediately via AST with no LLM; doc/paper/image changes only set a needs_update flag because they require LLM re-extraction.

nodes.label: Wiki Export (--wiki)
nodes.rationale: Agent-crawlable wiki (index.md + one article per community); must run before Step 9 cleanup so .graphify_labels.json is still available.

nodes.label: Neo4j Export
nodes.rationale: Uses MERGE statements so pushes are idempotent - safe to re-run without duplicates.

nodes.label: FalkorDB Export
nodes.rationale: FalkorDB's GRAPH.QUERY runs one statement at a time (no bulk script import like Neo4j's cypher-shell), so --falkordb-push is preferred over the cypher.txt artifact for actually loading a graph.

nodes.label: Graphify MCP Server
nodes.rationale: Stdio MCP server exposing query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, get_community, god_nodes, graph_stats, shortest_path so other agents can query the graph live; Claude Desktop config must use the absolute interpreter path because it cannot run $(...).

nodes.label: Token Reduction Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Only runs when total_words > 5000: for small corpora the graph's value is structural clarity, not token compression, so the benchmark is skipped silently.

nodes.label: Extraction Subagent Prompt
nodes.rationale: Passed verbatim to each semantic subagent with FILE_LIST/CHUNK_NUM/TOTAL_CHUNKS/DEEP_MODE/CHUNK_PATH substituted; loaded only when at least one chunk holds a doc, paper, or image.

nodes.label: Deterministic Node ID Format
nodes.rationale: IDs use the full repo-relative path stem so same-named files in different directories stay distinct and match AST-generated IDs; filename-only or immediate-parent-only IDs create orphan ghost-duplicate nodes, and chunk-number suffixes break determinism.

nodes.label: Discrete Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: Models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges: production showed a bimodal collapse (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+), so INFERRED edges must pick exactly one of 0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55 and never default to 0.5.

nodes.label: Hyperedges
nodes.rationale: Used sparingly (max 3 per chunk) only when a group of 3+ nodes shares a concept/flow/pattern that pairwise edges alone do not capture.

nodes.label: Verbatim source_file Rule
nodes.rationale: source_file must be copied character-for-character from FILE_LIST so the full build and incremental --update relativize against the same base, letting build_merge's replace-on-re-extract match existing nodes instead of accumulating duplicates.

nodes.label: GitHub Clone (graphify clone)
nodes.rationale: Clones into ~/.graphify/repos/<owner>/<repo> and reuses existing clones on repeat runs.

nodes.label: Cross-Repo Graph Merge (merge-graphs)
nodes.rationale: Each node in the merged graph carries a repo attribute for filtering by origin; for monorepos the CLI is run per subfolder (graphify-out inside each scanned path) because the skill pipeline would clobber one shared output dir.

nodes.label: Post-Commit Auto-Rebuild Hook
nodes.rationale: Triggers once per commit with no background process, works with any editor; detects changed code files via git diff HEAD~1 and re-runs only AST extraction. Doc/image changes are ignored (require manual --update). Appends to an existing post-commit hook rather than replacing it.

nodes.label: Native CLAUDE.md Integration
nodes.rationale: graphify claude install writes a ## graphify section to the project CLAUDE.md so Claude checks the graph before answering codebase questions and rebuilds after code changes - always-on, no manual /graphify needed.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: The query matcher is case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming, synonyms, or cross-language matching, so a wording mismatch returns 0 hits and the answer collapses to noise. Expansion picks up to 12 tokens strictly from the graph's own vocabulary - never invented tokens - and the selection is printed so it is auditable.

nodes.label: BFS/DFS Graph Traversal
nodes.rationale: BFS (default, depth 3) for broad 'what is X connected to' context; DFS (depth-limited to 6) to trace a specific chain. Output is token-budget aware, ranked by term relevance and cut at ~4 chars/token.

nodes.label: Inline NetworkX Fallback
nodes.rationale: When the graphify query CLI is unavailable, graph.json is loaded and traversed inline with NetworkX using the same substring matching, so queries never hard-fail on a missing CLI.

nodes.label: Work Memory (save-result Feedback Loop)
nodes.rationale: Every answered query is saved back with --outcome useful/dead_end/corrected so the next --update extracts the Q&A as a graph node; graphify reflect --if-stale refreshes LESSONS.md (preferred sources, known dead ends, corrections) cheaply at session start - a self-improving loop.

nodes.label: Whisper Video/Audio Transcription
nodes.rationale: Video/audio cannot be read directly, so Whisper transcribes them to text and the transcripts are treated as doc files in Step 3; JSON is written from Python rather than a shell redirect because Whisper's stdout progress would corrupt the file (#1392).

nodes.label: Whisper Domain Hint Prompt
nodes.rationale: The host agent composes a one-sentence domain hint from the corpus's god node labels and exports it as GRAPHIFY_WHISPER_PROMPT - no separate API call needed - improving transcription accuracy of domain terms; falls back to a generic punctuation prompt for video-only corpora.

nodes.label: Incremental Update (--update)
nodes.rationale: Re-extracts only new/changed files (detect_incremental diff against the saved manifest) to save tokens and time; code-only changes skip semantic extraction entirely, and the manifest is re-saved with root= so it stays portable across clones/machines (#1417).

nodes.label: Cluster-Only Rerun (--cluster-only)
nodes.rationale: Self-contained: re-clusters, names communities, and regenerates all outputs from the existing graph. Steps 5-9 must NOT be re-run because they read intermediate files that Step 9 cleanup already deleted (#1392).

nodes.label: build_merge Replace-on-Re-extract
nodes.rationale: Reads graph.json directly without a NetworkX round-trip so edge direction is preserved (#801); prune_sources is only for genuinely deleted files because changed files are reconciled by replace-on-re-extract (#1344), and root= relativizes prune paths so stale nodes do not accumulate (#1361). Hyperedges from both the existing graph and the new extraction are combined.

nodes.label: Google AdSense Publisher Authorization (ads.txt)
nodes.rationale: IAB ads.txt declaration authorizing Google (pub-3958503944876278) as a DIRECT seller of the site's ad inventory - required for AdSense to serve ads on the DropLife Brasil site.
